item.title: Emmanuel Grégoire elected Paris mayor, succeeding fellow left-winger Anne Hidalgo
item.summary: Socialist frontrunner Emmanuel Grégoire comfortably defeated veteran conservative Rachida Dati in a second-round runoff for Paris mayor on Sunday, defying forecasts of a close race to extend the left's quarter-century rule in the French capital.
